finalText:

Frozen: `account_id` in [docs/openapi.yaml:16](docs/openapi.yaml:16) and the `WIRE` values in [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8). The vendored SDK gets overwritten by `npm run vendor:refresh`. Next: ask who reads those audit fields.
